slots.node01.items.item01.body.item01.p: No roles are eliminated. Some tasks move; the role cards show which.

slots.node01.items.item01.title: Will I lose my job?
slots.node01.items.item02.body.item01.p: Eight hours in the four weeks before your site goes live, scheduled by your manager.

slots.node01.items.item02.title: When is my training?
slots.node01.items.item03.body.item01.p: A paper downtime kit and a hotline run for the first two weeks.

slots.node01.items.item03.title: If the system is down?
slots.node02.items.item01.body.item01.p: Your floor-walker first, then the service desk hotline.

slots.node02.items.item01.title: Who do I call?
slots.node02.items.item02.body.item01.p: Templates are rebuilt once by each clinic; your lead signs off.

slots.node02.items.item02.title: Keep my old templates?
slots.node02.items.item03.body.item01.p: Email, text and lobby signs begin four weeks before your site goes live.
